name: Fiend
soul: The soul of one who feels everything at once and has never managed to hide any of it.
spark: The mote is warm to hold a hand near. It leans toward anything that will burn, and toward you when you are angry.

hybrid.text: It burns because it is angry, and it is angry on your behalf.

settled.name: Wick-fiend
settled.text: A flame the size of a candle's with two horns and a temper. It has set fire to your bedding once and is not sorry.
settled.sign: A candle flame with two horns and a scowl. It burns taller when you are cross.
settled.habit: It sits in the candlestick and leans toward anything on the table that would burn.

paths.name: Flare-up
paths.of: one who cannot take a hurt quietly
paths.text: It learned from you that a hurt is not a thing to take quietly. Struck, it doubles in size, and it does not come down until something has paid.
paths.sign: It is twice the size it was a moment ago, with its mouth open, looking for who did it.
paths.habit: It flares at slammed doors, dropped plates and raised voices, and settles again, muttering.

prongs.name: Blade-rider
prongs.of: one who is first into a quarrel and last out of it
prongs.text: It rides your blade to the foe and stays on the foe when the blade comes back.
prongs.sign: It clings along the flat of a blade, small and white-hot, with its heels dug in.
prongs.habit: It sleeps in the scabbard and scorches the lining.

finishes.name: Slag-fiend
finishes.of: one who holds on until the thing gives
finishes.text: Metal runs where it grips. What it has hold of is not armoured any more.
finishes.sign: A skin of cooled iron, cracked, with the glow showing through the cracks.
finishes.habit: It handles the fire-irons until they droop.

finishes.name: Pyre-dancer
finishes.of: one who cannot keep still when angry
finishes.text: It is never where the blow lands, and everywhere it has just been is alight.
finishes.sign: Long thin legs of flame, never both on the ground. It leaves a line of small fires.
finishes.habit: It hops from candle to candle down the hall table and back.

prongs.name: Slung Coal
prongs.of: one who throws the first thing to hand
prongs.text: It goes out on your shot like a coal in a sling.
prongs.sign: It sits balled tight in the hand with its claws dug in, hot, waiting to be thrown.
prongs.habit: It jumps from your hand to the far wall and back when it is bored.

finishes.name: Falling Coal
finishes.of: one whose anger comes down from a long way up
finishes.text: Thrown high, it comes down white. The ground keeps the mark all season.
finishes.sign: Two ragged wings of flame it can only fall with. It burns white at the top of the arc.
finishes.habit: It climbs the chimney and comes down it again, fast.

finishes.name: Fiend on the Hill
finishes.of: one who burns where everyone can see, and means to be seen
finishes.text: It burns on the hill above a dark post so the car can find you. Things that hate the light find it first.
finishes.sign: It stands on the highest thing near, holding its own flame overhead like a lamp.
finishes.habit: It climbs to the roof-ridge at dusk and burns there until the last car is in.

prongs.name: Short Fuse
prongs.of: one who goes from calm to blazing with no step between
prongs.text: It goes from nothing to everything between one breath and the next. It is sorry afterward, briefly, and the room is warm.
prongs.sign: A short black wick stands up from its head, always a little alight at the tip.
prongs.habit: It sits quite still with its eyes shut, smoking faintly, and you learn to leave it.

finishes.name: Brush-burner
finishes.of: one whose anger spreads to everything standing near
finishes.text: Hurt you in the green and it gets into the undergrowth. After that it is not one fiend.
finishes.sign: Smoke trails off it in several directions at once, and there are small flames in the smoke.
finishes.habit: It singes the edges of whatever it sits on: mats, books, the hem of your coat.

finishes.name: Toll-fire
finishes.of: one who burns what it costs them and calls it light
finishes.text: Each firing of your Pattern costs you, and it burns the cost for light. The chain shows brighter each time.
finishes.sign: A ring of fire turns round it, a little wider each time it has been lit.
finishes.habit: It burns small things you have finished with: stubs, wrappers, an old list.

paths.name: Banked Coal
paths.of: one who keeps a grudge warm
paths.text: It learned from you that an injury can be kept. It lies under its own ash, red at the centre, with a list of who it is waiting for.
paths.sign: Grey with ash and nearly dark, until a certain name is said. Then the red shows through.
paths.habit: It rakes ash over itself at night and is still alight in the morning.

prongs.name: Oath-scorch
prongs.of: one who swore to get even and wrote it where it can be seen
prongs.text: Your Terms are burned into the air where you swore them. It tends the letters.
prongs.sign: Letters of fire hang over its head like a crown. It trims them when they blur.
prongs.habit: It writes on the hearthstone with one finger and reads it over.

finishes.name: Mark of the Sworn
finishes.of: one who made the promise part of their body
finishes.text: It has marked you, by agreement. While the Terms hold, the mark is cool. You know what happens otherwise.
finishes.sign: A chain of small bright links is burned round its wrist, and a matching one round yours.
finishes.habit: It holds its marked wrist against yours for a moment each morning. Both are cool.

finishes.name: Vendetta
finishes.of: one who has not forgiven a single one of them
finishes.text: It keeps a coal lit for each named beast that marked you. It blows on them at night.
finishes.sign: A string of small coals hangs from its neck, each on its own link, each still lit.
finishes.habit: It blows on each coal in turn at night and says a name over it.

prongs.name: Bottle-fiend
prongs.of: one who keeps it stoppered and takes it out to look at
prongs.text: It moved into a thing you dug out of a ruin, and comes out when the thing is rubbed, grumbling.
prongs.sign: It lives in an old stopped flask, and its light shows through the glass, pressed small.
prongs.habit: It comes out when the flask is rubbed, complains about the room, and goes back in.

finishes.name: Fiend of the Stopped Bottle
finishes.of: one who will not come out and discuss it
finishes.text: The Archive wants the bottle back. It has explained to the Archive, at length, that it is not in.
finishes.sign: A brass-bound bottle, hot to hold. A voice inside says that nobody is at home.
finishes.habit: It turns the bottle to face the wall when you have annoyed it.

finishes.name: Seal-burner
finishes.of: one who opens what was closed against them, neatly
finishes.text: It melts the wax on every writ you carry and reseals it better. It has read them all.
finishes.sign: Small quick hands with wax on them, and a seal that looks untouched until you hold it to the light.
finishes.habit: It softens wax between its palms and presses its thumb in, over and over.

prongs.name: Smoke-reader
prongs.of: one who watches for the sign that it is time
prongs.text: It reads what is coming in its own smoke, and leans the way you should go.
prongs.sign: Its smoke goes up in one straight thread, and it watches where the thread bends.
prongs.habit: It sits upwind of you and studies its own smoke.

finishes.name: Ash-reader
finishes.of: one who can tell you who went in and did not come out
finishes.text: It sifts the ash at the mouth of the deep places and tells you who went in and did not come out.
finishes.sign: Grey to the elbows, with old red eyes. It sifts whatever has burned through its fingers.
finishes.habit: It rakes through the cold grate every morning before anyone is up.

finishes.name: Last Red Coal
finishes.of: one who can hold a single point of feeling through anything
finishes.text: In the Quiet it goes down to one red point and holds it. That point is the only warm thing for a mile.
finishes.sign: One red point in a body gone grey and still. It is the only warm thing for a long way.
finishes.habit: It goes down to a single coal and holds there for hours, and does not go out.

paths.name: Grate-fiend
paths.of: one who learned to be warm instead of dangerous
paths.text: It learned from you that a fire kept is worth more than a fire thrown.
paths.sign: It burns low and even behind its own crossed arms, like a fire behind a grate.
paths.habit: It moves to whoever in the room is coldest, and denies it.

prongs.name: Stove-devil
prongs.of: one who looks after everybody out of spite
prongs.text: The cohort built it a stove so it would stop sleeping in the coal scuttle. It heats the whole dormitory out of spite.
prongs.sign: An iron stove with horns cast into the lid and a red eye behind the door.
prongs.habit: It rattles its own lid at mealtimes until somebody cooks.

finishes.name: Three-legged Stove
finishes.of: one who will not let a friend eat cold
finishes.text: It walks on three iron legs and the party eats hot. Nobody who shared its fire has been left on the line.
finishes.sign: It walks on three jointed iron legs with a pot on, and has not spilled.
finishes.habit: It follows the hungriest person in the room about until they sit down.

finishes.name: Watchfire Fiend
finishes.of: one who stays lit so that others can find their way back
finishes.text: Set it down at the post and it burns there till morning. What it lights, it guards.
finishes.sign: The stove door stands open at night, and the light from it reaches further than it should.
finishes.habit: It burns all night at one height, and is found at dawn exactly as it was left.

prongs.name: Cauteriser
prongs.text: It closes your wounds the only way it knows. It works. You will not thank it at the time.
prongs.sign: Small hot hands, held carefully away from things. The fingertips are white.
prongs.habit: It warms its hands over itself before it touches you. It is still too hot.

finishes.name: Scar-smith
finishes.of: one who is proud of having mended what it could not prevent
finishes.text: Every wound of yours it sealed is a line of bright metal now. It is proud of the work.
finishes.sign: Its forearms are plated in bright metal, and it carries a tiny hammer of the same.
finishes.habit: It polishes your old scars with a thumb when you are asleep.

finishes.name: Ward-flame
finishes.of: one who draws a line and stands on it
finishes.text: It burns along the edge of your wards, and nothing has yet wished to cross it twice.
finishes.sign: A low ring of blue flame burns round its feet wherever it stops.
finishes.habit: It walks round your bed once before it settles, leaving a faint warm line.

prongs.name: Bedside Fiend
prongs.of: one who burns low so that another can sleep
prongs.text: It burns low beside your bed, and brighter when something outside is thinking about the window.
prongs.sign: Its lower jaw is a small lamp. It keeps its mouth nearly shut, and the room is dim and warm.
prongs.habit: It sits on the night table and brightens, slightly, at every sound from outside.

finishes.name: Wake-candle
finishes.of: one who keeps a light for those who are gone
finishes.text: It burns at the hearth for the hall's dead. They come to it as moths would, if moths had names.
finishes.sign: A tall still flame with a cold blue heart. It does not flicker when the door opens.
finishes.habit: It stands on the hearthstone at the lamp hour and burns down a finger's width, no more.

finishes.name: Thaw-fiend
finishes.of: one who does what they hate because someone needs it
finishes.text: Ice goes out ahead of it and the river lets you through. It hates the water and does it anyway.
finishes.sign: It steams. Meltwater runs from its feet, and it lifts each foot out of the wet with distaste.
finishes.habit: It sits on the frozen pump every winter morning until the water comes.
